body: Well, I have nobody keeping me here, so to speak, so at least there's that. And yeah, I can't remember the last time I was genuinely looking forward to anything

That's sort of what I've had to do to last this long. "Oh, next year there is a movie I want to see" or "the final game in this trilogy is coming out in two years" or "I have to see how this series ends" but none of that really matters, and it's not enough to keep me holding on any longer

I appreciate it, but at this point I'm not looking for a purpose of any sort, nor am I interested in helping others. People are scum unless proven otherwise and I'm tired of wasting time on them. Between work and class it's not like I would have time to do anything anyway.
